persona: Bank network security lead moving into security architecture
resumeText:
Aditya Deshmukh | Mumbai | aditya.deshmukh@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Network Security Lead, Konkan Coastal Bank, Mumbai (2018 - present)
- Designed network segmentation for 220 branches and the data centre.
- Ran firewall rule reviews on Palo Alto and Check Point every quarter.
- Rolled out MFA for all administrators and privileged access management for 400 server accounts.
- Managed the internal PKI and TLS certificate renewals for 90 applications.
- Led the risk assessment for the new UPI switch.
- Mapped network controls to ISO 27001 and the RBI cyber security framework for audits.
- Presented quarterly network risk reports to the CISO.

Network Engineer, Arabian Sea Networks, Mumbai (2014 - 2018)
- Configured branch VPNs and core switches.

SKILLS
Zero trust, Palo Alto, Check Point, CyberArk

EDUCATION
BE Electronics and Telecommunication, Mumbai University, 2014

CERTIFICATIONS
CCNP Security (2017)
